context: The prompt requests moving iteration metadata (ID and Name) from the Workdir tab to the Active Prompt page title area, while excluding Total Prompts, Next ID, and Git fields. This questionnaire clarifies specific implementation details about the placement, formatting, and user interaction aspects of this change.

questions.question-text: Where exactly should the iteration metadata be displayed in the Active Prompt page title area?

options.label: In the card header next to 'Active Prompt' title, on the same line as a subtitle
options.pros: Compact layout, keeps header single-height, metadata always visible with the title
options.cons: May become crowded if iteration name is long, less visual prominence for the metadata

options.label: In the card header as a second row below the 'Active Prompt' title
options.pros: Clear separation between title and metadata, easier to read, more space for longer iteration names
options.cons: Takes more vertical space, pushes content down slightly

options.label: Inside the card body at the very top, above all other content
options.pros: Doesn't modify header structure, easier to implement, metadata still prominent
options.cons: Not technically in the title area, may be less visible than header placement

options.label: As a small badge or pill next to the 'Active Prompt' title in the header
options.pros: Compact and modern appearance, uses Bootstrap badge components, minimal space usage
options.cons: May be difficult to read if iteration names are long, less readable for IDs

questions.recommendation-rationale: Displaying the metadata in the card header on the same line keeps it compact and always visible when viewing the Active Prompt page. The iteration ID and name are typically short enough to fit comfortably without crowding the header, and this placement maintains the cleanest visual hierarchy.

questions.question-text: How should the iteration metadata be formatted and styled?

options.label: Use a muted text style with labels, e.g., 'Iteration: ITR-... | Name: ...'
options.pros: Clear labels make it obvious what each value represents, easy to scan
options.cons: More verbose, takes more horizontal space

options.label: Display as compact inline elements without labels, separated by a separator like ' • ' or ' | '
options.pros: Minimal space usage, clean modern look, less visual clutter
options.cons: May not be immediately clear what the values represent to new users

options.label: Show iteration name prominently with ID in parentheses or as a badge, e.g., 'Sprint 1 (ITR-...)' or 'Sprint 1 ITR-...'
options.pros: Emphasizes the human-readable name, ID still available for reference, natural reading order
options.cons: Less emphasis on the iteration ID which may be needed for technical references

options.label: Use a Bootstrap badge or pill component for each piece of metadata
options.pros: Visually distinct from other text, modern appearance, color-coded possible
options.cons: May look inconsistent with the rest of the header, takes more space

questions.recommendation-rationale: Displaying the iteration name prominently with the ID in parentheses provides the most user-friendly format. The iteration name is what users typically reference in conversation, while the ID remains available for technical tracking. This format is intuitive and follows common UI patterns.

questions.question-text: Should the metadata be displayed only when a prompt is active, or also when no active prompt exists?

options.label: Only display when an active prompt exists
options.pros: Simpler logic, metadata only shown when relevant to the active prompt context
options.cons: Users won't see iteration info when no prompt is active, may need to navigate to Workdir tab

options.label: Always display in the Active Prompt page header, even when no prompt is active
options.pros: Iteration info always accessible, users always know which iteration they're working in
options.cons: May seem odd to show iteration info when the 'no active prompt' message is displayed

questions.recommendation-rationale: Displaying the iteration metadata regardless of active prompt state provides consistent context to the user. Since the Active Prompt page is the default landing page, showing the iteration info helps users always know which work iteration they're in, even when creating a new prompt.

questions.question-text: Should the iteration metadata in the Workdir tab be modified after moving ID and Name to Active Prompt?

options.label: Remove ID and Name entirely from Workdir tab, keep only Total Prompts, Next ID, and Git
options.pros: Avoids duplication, cleaner Workdir display, follows DRY principle
options.cons: Users on Workdir tab won't see iteration identity without scrolling to prompts table or switching tabs

options.label: Keep all metadata in Workdir tab unchanged (showing ID, Name, Total Prompts, Next ID, Git)
options.pros: Workdir tab remains self-contained with complete info, no context loss when on that tab
options.cons: Duplication of ID and Name across tabs, may confuse users about the single source of truth

options.label: Show ID and Name in Workdir tab, but remove or hide Total Prompts, Next ID, and Git as requested
options.pros: Keeps core identity visible on Workdir tab, removes extraneous fields per prompt requirements
options.cons: Total Prompts, Next ID, and Git info becomes harder to access, may still duplicate ID and Name

questions.recommendation-rationale: The prompt explicitly states to move the metadata to Active Prompt and not show Total Prompts, Next ID, Git. Removing ID and Name from Workdir after moving them prevents duplication and maintains a single source of truth. Users can still see the iteration identity from the Active Prompt page, and the Workdir tab can focus on the prompts table itself.

questions.question-text: Should the iteration metadata be clickable or interactive in any way?

options.label: Keep it as static text display only
options.pros: Simple implementation, clear that it's informational, no unexpected behaviors
options.cons: Missed opportunity for potential future interactions like editing iteration name

options.label: Make it clickable to navigate to the Workdir tab
options.pros: Provides quick navigation to iteration management, intuitive interaction
options.cons: May not be discoverable, users might not expect it to be clickable

options.label: Add a small info icon that shows iteration details in a tooltip
options.pros: Provides additional context on demand, doesn't clutter the header, progressive disclosure
options.cons: Extra implementation complexity, may not be necessary for simple ID and name display

questions.recommendation-rationale: Static text display is the simplest and most appropriate solution for this prompt. The metadata serves as contextual information, and users already have clear navigation tabs if they need to access iteration management features. Adding interactivity would introduce complexity without clear user benefit.
